meta.name: web-stack-planner
meta.description: Collect project brief and stack choices, then output canonical project-config.json for downstream web-builder skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集项目需求与技术选型，生成标准配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个web构建技能间共享统一的项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Collect project brief and tech choices, output canonical config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a unified project config across multiple web builder skills

howto.what: 它会询问你的项目名称、类型、目标用户、认证需求等，然后让你从预设的前端、后端、数据库、CSS框架、集成服务和部署平台中做选择，最后生成一个标准的项目配置文件。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新Web项目，需要规划技术栈时，可以要求它帮你做规划。

say.text: 帮我规划一个电商网站的技术栈
say.note: 它会开始询问项目细节并引导你选择技术栈。
它会基于你的选择生成配置文件。

howto.what_en: It asks for project name, type, target audience, authentication needs, and lets you choose from preset frontend, backend, database, CSS framework, integration services, and deployment options, then generates a canonical project-config.json.
howto.when_en: When you start a new web project and need to plan the tech stack, you can ask it to help plan.

say_en.text: Plan a tech stack for an e-commerce site.
say_en.note: It will start asking project details and guide you through choices.

say_en.text: I want a blog with Next.js and Tailwind.
say_en.note: It will generate a config based on your choices.
